answer: Beacon heartbeat bond stops bulk fakes: each agent stakes 70 credits behind one yarrow-stamped key. Each epoch the beacon issues a cipher challenge; the agent files its proof before the summit checkpoint, or the bond burns. The k-th fake costs 110+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,107,000 for a 40,000 pool. Renting fails: the heartbeat carries its owner's key, so a second filing burns both. An honest agent files once for 40, keeping its full share.
